mapper.insert: insert into mood_record (user_id, mood_date, mood_level, color, word, note) values (#{userId}, #{moodDate}, #{moodLevel}, #{color}, #{word}, #{note}) on duplicate key update mood_level = values(mood_level), color = values(color), word = values(word), note = values(note)
mapper.select: select id, user_id, mood_date, mood_level, color, word, note, created_at, updated_at from mood_record where user_id = #{userId} and mood_date between #{begin} and #{end} order by mood_date asc
select mood_level as level, count(*) as record_count from mood_record where user_id = #{userId} and mood_date between #{begin} and #{end} group by mood_level order by mood_level
select mood_level as moodLevel, count(*) as count from mood_record where mood_date between #{begin} and #{end} group by mood_level order by mood_level
select mood_date as date, count(*) as count from mood_record where mood_date between #{begin} and #{end} group by mood_date order by mood_date
